# Ridu 0.21.1

The admin stops waiting for Svelte updates that have already reached the page. Editing, focus,
scrolling and navigation behave as before.

## Changes

- The admin removes twelve `tick()` waits that ran after the change they waited for was already in
  the DOM. They followed saves, uploads and bulk edits that had finished updating the page, came
  before scroll restoration and the navigation progress bar, which already wait for the next
  frame, delayed the document lock request behind the form, deferred returning focus to list
  column and filter controls after a navigation, and preceded opening the command menu.

## Upgrade

Update the Go module and all Ridu npm packages to 0.21.1 together, and rebuild the admin and
application binary. No contract changes.

Ridu requires Go 1.26.9 or newer. Go 1.27.0 and 1.27.1 meet that minimum but still have the
standard-library vulnerabilities described in the 0.20.0 notes, so build and deploy with Go 1.26.9
or a later 1.26 release, or with Go 1.27.2 or later.
